## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.random`)

```pycon
>>> from scikitplot.random import default_rng, kiss_context
>>> rng = default_rng(42)
>>> data = rng.random(1000)

Context manager

>>> with default_rng(42) as rng:
...     data = rng.random(1000)
>>>
>>> with kiss_context(42) as rng:
...     data = rng.random(1000)
```
